assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with supraventricular tachycardia
The patient has a background of known atherosclerotic heart disease of the native coronary artery
The diagnoses are I47.1 and I25.10
Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to capture intermittent arrhythmic events and correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances in an outpatient setting
The service supports the medical necessity of this diagnostic monitoring service claimed against denial code CO-197
